description: Fields a connector in this repository puts in an item's body that the core's types do not hold, so the core passes over them and they never reach the chat. Each is in docs/open-questions.md, Q-01 ('Fields only the prototype has, from Hermes and OpenClaw'), for the connector that produces it to bring up. The checks in packages/claude-code, packages/openclaw and python/tests allow these and no other field outside the schema; the test in crates/marmot-agent/src/socket/corpus.rs fails once the types hold one, so it comes off this list. A path is the field's place in the body: [] stands for each entry of a list.
